matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the incorrect ordering and definition of encryption matrices P_k and Q in equation (1), breaking the ISVD logic. Neither finding addresses equation (1) or the encryption step; pred_id 1 focuses on leverage scores (eq. 5) and pred_id 2 on sampling distribution (eq. 6).

GT2 identifies that equation (5)'s leverage score formula is ill-formed due to ambiguous indexing and vector-matrix multiplication issues. Pred_id 1 directly addresses equation (5), pointing out that the leverage scores as defined yield uniform values (all equal to 1), making them meaningless for importance weighting—this is the detectable symptom of the malformed formula.

GT3 concerns inconsistent temperature scaling definitions in equations (7) and (9) and their relationship to sample weights. Neither finding discusses temperature scaling, equation (7), equation (9), or the TTS loss formulation; they focus on leverage scores and sampling distributions instead.
